newsitem.title: UK: Games Workshop higher after record profits.
newsitem.headline: Games Workshop higher after record profits.

text.p: Shares in Games Workshop Group rose on Tuesday after the UK games manufacturer posted record interim pre-tax profits of 4.80 million stg, traders said.
The stock was up 21p at 534-1/2 by 1030MT.
Pre-tax profits rose 51 percent to 4.80 million stg for the six months ended December 1 versus 3.17 million for the same period the year before.
"They are good results," one trader said. "We've seen some good buyers on the back of them."
The interim dividend was 2.6p, up from 2.0p the year before.

"The directors believe that the continuing investment in all areas of the Group provides the basis for future growth and can be financed out of the Group's cash resources," group chairman Brian North said in a statement.
The results followed increased turnover of 27.62 million stg, up from 19.51 million the year before.
